source: stdout of vswhere.exe -all -products * -utf8 -property installationPath on a Windows 11 build machine, captured through execFileSync with encoding utf8. Kept as a JSON string so git cannot normalize its CRLF line endings. -products * also lists a product that is not Visual Studio (SQL Server Management Studio), and the output ends in a CRLF.
